en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, steep rocky hill rising above patchwork fields and wooded slopes. The main title in red at the top left reads "Bilin, der Borschen". Along the left margin is vertical red text, and along the right margin is vertical red publisher information including the name 'Brück & Sohn, Meißen'. The overall style is that of an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
